title: Peace and Quiet Bedroom 1
description:
The country is calling your name.  So quiet, yet so close to Nashville and all it has to offer.  Enjoy the spacious deck or the front porch.  Both have beautiful scenic country views.  The room is spacious and has a huge walk-in closet.  Bring your pets and kids.  We love and welcome everyone.

The space
I have five acres you can roam.  Enjoy the peaceful sunrises and sunsets.  Visit my hens and collect some eggs - brown, green, blue, and if you're lucky, a pink one.  Bring a tent and camp under the stars next to the creek.

Guest access
You have access to the rented bedroom, bathroom, laundry room, living room, dining room, kitchen, mud room, garage, front porch, back deck, and the whole yard.  Your pets can enjoy the fenced area in the front yard or unfenced anywhere else.

Other things to note
Easy drive to Nashville.  Quiet and safe.  Plenty of room to roam.  Extra large room with walk-in closet.  This is the best place to stay!
